business_problem: To streamline vehicle purchasing for consumers and dealerships, Tekion aimed to create a unified, cloud-native platform that uses generative AI.
solution_summary: Tekion built this solution on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure. To streamline vehicle purchasing for consumers and dealerships, Tekion aimed to create a unified, cloud-native platform that uses generative AI. Azure OpenAI Service provides the generative AI model layer used for summarization, drafting, classification, or copilots in the workflow. Azure Kubernetes Service orchestrates containerized workloads at scale. Azure Cosmos DB stores operational data that needs globally distributed, low-latency access. Azure provides the core cloud infrastructure, security boundary, and managed services underpinning the solution.
